newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sime Darby to buy rest of PSD Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Sime Darby to buy rest of PSD Holdings.

text.p: Malaysian conglomerate Sime Darby Bhd said on Wednesday it has agreed to acquire the remaining 49 percent equity in PSD Holdings Bhd which it does not own, for 158.03 million ringgit in cash.
Sime said in a statement that the stake will be acquired from PERNAS Mining Sdn Bhd, a unit of Pernas International Holdings Bhd.
PSD Holdings is an investment holding company with interests in insurance, broking, manufacturing, freight forwarding and duty free consumer products business.
Upon completion of the acquisition, Sime will provide sufficient inter-company loans to enable PSD Holdings to discharge advances made to it by PERNAS Mining amounting to about 20.6 million ringgit.
